weekly-class-count.definition: Four Youth/Teen and five Adult recurring group sessions in the published schedule.

class-cap.definition: Maximum planned students per small-group class; a coaching constraint, not scarcity messaging.

core-culture-rhythm.definition: Three planned classes per week, up to 36 scheduled classes over the first 12-week term.

first-year-class-count.period: First 12 months at 6045 Main Street: 2025-08-04 through 2026-08-03
first-year-class-count.aggregation: 135 Adult sessions plus deduplicated Youth/Kids session dates
first-year-class-count.definition: A delivered session is a recorded class-session row. Youth and Kids rows sharing a date count as one Youth session; Adult sessions count separately.
first-year-class-count.publicWording: 294 classes delivered during our first 12 months at 6045 Main Street.

reconciliation.result: Verified under the workbook counting rule; prior 293 figure superseded.

median-class-size.aggregation: median recorded attendees per delivered group session
median-class-size.definition: Adult rows count separately; Youth and Kids rows sharing a date are combined into one Youth session. Report N, date window, quartiles, and maximum; do not imply student outcomes.
median-class-size.publicWording: Median recorded class size: 3 students across 294 sessions.

intro-funnel.period: Defined cohort and date window required
intro-funnel.aggregation: reserved → attended → first class attended → Core Culture started
intro-funnel.definition: Operational funnel only; conversion rates remain private by default.

term-completion-rate.definition: A completer reaches the end of the first paid term without cancellation or refund; this is not a student quality score.

renewal-rate.definition: Continuation is measured separately from first-term completion and remains a choice, not an attendance virtue.

session.deliveredDefinition: Calendar session not canceled; reconcile status in the canonical calendar before counting.
